response.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL AND link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(amount) AS overall_avg FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT ev.link_to_event, ev.avg_amount, ev.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS above_overall FROM ev CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE ev.avg_amount > o.overall_avg) SELECT link_to_event, avg_amount, above_overall, avg_amount - (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) FROM kept) AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM kept ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is the mean of amount over all non-null budget lines (including any lines with null link_to_event); events are grouped by budget.link_to_event with null event links excluded from the per-event groups.
The 'mean of the kept events' averages' is computed over all kept events (before the top 10 limit), as an unweighted mean of the per-event averages.
